name: spike
workload: PHASE_16_PLAN.md section 5.1's spike profile: the target's mix at its peak, three spikes of ten times it for 10 s each, 170 s at the peak after each, with same-key retries and one keyed command in twenty sent once (P16-TSK-016): admission, shedding before any claim, and recovery without a restart; ten times the peak runs past the platform's break by design, so an iteration the generator cannot start there is recorded, not failed

operations.name: bnpl
operations.reason: a BNPL purchase rests on a credit approval, and on kind none is possible, automatic or by a person: every credit policy's exposure rule reads the bureau's total balance, no kind deployment can configure a bureau (the application refuses one until CURRENT_STATE's unresolved question 13 is answered), so the exposure is unassessed and the policy's fallback declines or refers (INV-CRD-10), and a person's approval of a referral is refused while it is (credit.ExposureUnassessable, INV-CRD-09); a simulated bureau on kind is an application change, routed to P16-TSK-018 (E20's simulated bureau); its instalments need its agreements

operations.name: lending
operations.reason: a repayment needs a disbursed loan, and a loan rests on a credit approval, and on kind none is possible, automatic or by a person: every credit policy's exposure rule reads the bureau's total balance, no kind deployment can configure a bureau (the application refuses one until CURRENT_STATE's unresolved question 13 is answered), so the exposure is unassessed and the policy's fallback declines or refers (INV-CRD-10), and a person's approval of a referral is refused while it is (credit.ExposureUnassessable, INV-CRD-09); a simulated bureau on kind is an application change, routed to P16-TSK-018 (E20's simulated bureau)

operations.name: credit
operations.reason: a decision reads the bureau and financial data, neither configurable on kind (the application refuses either until CURRENT_STATE's unresolved questions 13 and 14 are answered), so every decision there is the fail-safe path, waiting its 30-minute collection window and referring (INV-CRD-10), which is E20's subject and not the target's decision; a decision with data needs a simulated bureau on kind, an application change, routed to P16-TSK-018
